rest-module-personaldashboard.v0-desc: Feeds of recent activity for PersonalDashboard modules
personal-dashboard-rest-endpoint-summary: Get feed items from the requested sources
personal-dashboard-rest-endpoint-desc-fe: Returns a merged feed of items drawn from the requested sources, newest first.
personal-dashboard-rest-param-desc-feed-: [Feed sources](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:PersonalDashboard/API#Sources) to draw from, separated by `|`. Items are spread evenly across them.
Maximum number of items to return
Opaque token from a previous response, to fetch the next page of the same feed.
personal-dashboard-rest-schema-desc-feed: The feed, newest first, spread evenly across the requested sources.
Token to pass back as `continue` for the next page. Absent once every source is spent.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-id: Identifier for this item, unique across every source in one response.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-fe: Name of the feed source this item came from.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ti: Title of the page that was edited.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-pa: Page ID of the page that was edited.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ol: Revision ID this edit was made from, or `null` if the edit created the page.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-us: Name of the user who made the edit, or their IP address if they were not logged in.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ti: When the edit was made, in ISO 8601 format.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ne: Size of the page after the edit, in bytes.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ol: Size of the page before the edit, in bytes.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-pa: Edit summary as parsed HTML. Empty if the summary is hidden from you.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-de: Short description of the page. Empty if the page has none.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-mi: Whether the edit was marked as minor.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-bo: Whether the edit was made by a bot.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ne: Whether the edit created the page.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ta: Change tags applied to the edit.
personal-dashboard-rest-feed-bad-continu: The continue value is not usable here. Request the feed again without it.
